title: Intraday momentum: strong early-UTC-day move predicts late-day continuation
rule_summary: Hourly candles, UTC clock. At the close of the 03:00 UTC bar (the bar covering 03:00-04:00), compute r = that close / open of the 00:00 UTC bar of the same day - 1. If r >= +1.0% and no position is open, buy at the open of the next bar (04:00 UTC). Exit at the close of the 15:00 UTC bar (executed at the 16:00 open) regardless of price. Stop: exit if a closed 1h bar is 2.5% below entry. At most one trade per day per pair. No other filters. All signals hourly.
mechanism: The source reports that the early-session return positively predicts a later-session return and attributes it to liquidity provision (dealers laying off inventory gradually), not late news. The other side is those who sell into the early move too cheaply and must re-buy later. The source defines sessions by volume, not UTC clock, so fixed UTC windows are an adaptation. The gross move after a >=1% early move must exceed 0.35% to pay; this is not guaranteed.
